verses.pali: Ekaṁ samayaṁ āyasmā sāriputto magadhesu viharati nālakagāmake.
verses.english: At one time Venerable Sāriputta was staying in the land of the Magadhans near the little village of Nālaka.

verses.pali: Atha kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako yenāyasmā sāriputto tenupasaṅkami; upasaṅkamitvā āyasmatā sāriputtena saddhiṁ sammodi.
verses.english: Then the wanderer Sāmaṇḍakāni went up to Venerable Sāriputta and exchanged greetings with him.

verses.pali: Sammodanīyaṁ kathaṁ sāraṇīyaṁ vītisāretvā ekamantaṁ nisīdi. Ekamantaṁ nisinno kho sāmaṇḍakāni paribbājako āyasmantaṁ sāriputtaṁ etadavoca:
verses.english: When the greetings and polite conversation were over, Sāmaṇḍakāni sat down to one side, and said to Sāriputta:

verses.pali: “Kiṁ nu kho, āvuso sāriputta, sukhaṁ, kiṁ dukkhan”ti?
verses.english: “Reverend Sāriputta, what is happiness and what is suffering?”
“Rebirth is suffering, reverend, no rebirth is happiness.

verses.pali: Abhinibbattiyā, āvuso, sati idaṁ dukkhaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: When there is rebirth, you can expect this kind of suffering.

verses.pali: sītaṁ uṇhaṁ jighacchā pipāsā uccāro passāvo aggisamphasso daṇḍasamphasso satthasamphasso ñātīpi mittāpi saṅgamma samāgamma rosenti.
verses.english: Cold, heat, hunger, thirst, defecation, and urination. Contact with fire, clubs, and knives. And relatives and friends get together and annoy you.

verses.pali: Abhinibbattiyā, āvuso, sati idaṁ dukkhaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ.
verses.english: When there is rebirth, this is the kind of suffering you can expect.

verses.pali: Anabhinibbattiyā, āvuso, sati idaṁ sukhaṁ pāṭikaṅkhaṁ—
verses.english: When there is no rebirth, you can expect this kind of happiness.

verses.pali: na sītaṁ na uṇhaṁ na jighacchā na pipāsā na uccāro na passāvo na aggisamphasso na daṇḍasamphasso na satthasamphasso ñātīpi mittāpi saṅgamma samāgamma na rosenti.
verses.english: No cold, heat, hunger, thirst, defecation, or urination. No contact with fire, clubs, or knives. And relatives and friends don’t get together and annoy you.

verses.pali: Anabhinibbattiyā, āvuso, sati idaṁ sukhaṁ pāṭikaṅkhan”ti.
verses.english: When there is no rebirth, this is the kind of happiness you can expect.”
